shots.focal_element: Glowing ClickUp ring mark resolving into the 'ClickUp AI' wordmark on black
shots.transition_other: video start; no incoming transition (anchors transition_in is null)
shots.typography: Geometric sans wordmark, bold weight, title case, tight tracking; 'AI' first appears as a thin neon outline glyph that fills to solid white. Font guess (low confidence): ClickUp's custom/Axiforma-like geometric sans.
shots.what_happens: On a black field a small neon purple/blue ring spins in, then 'ClickUp' types/reveals letter by letter to its right and 'AI' draws on as an outlined glyph before resolving solid; a soft radial glow surrounds the mark. Two reverse-swoosh SFX candidates (x001, x002) sit in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: On a black background, scale-and-rotate in a glowing ring logo with a radial bloom, reveal the wordmark letters left-to-right with a per-character stagger, then stroke-draw 'AI' as an outline and cross-fade it to a solid fill by ~1.5 s.

shots.focal_element: ClickUp Doc window titled 'Go-To-Market Launch Plan' floating on a teal wave wallpaper
on_screen_text: The new launch plan will include
shots.typography: Product UI text: neutral grotesque sans (Inter-like, low confidence); doc title large bold title case with tight tracking, body and metadata small regular weight, breadcrumb small medium weight.
shots.what_happens: The logo zooms through with heavy motion blur into a clean, rounded app window showing a near-empty Doc with only the line 'The new launch plan will include'. Around 3.5 s a dark notification toast slides in at the top right (text too small to read here), and the camera begins a blurred push toward it at the end of the shot. An impact SFX candidate (x003) lands near the cut-in.
shots.build_rebuild: Zoom-blur the logo out into a centered rounded-corner app window with a soft drop shadow over a teal gradient wallpaper, hold ~1.5 s, slide a dark toast in at top-right, then start a fast motion-blurred camera push toward the toast.

shots.focal_element: Dark 'New comment from CEO' notification card in the upper right
on_screen_text: “CODE RED: Our competitor just released a similar product. Let’s pull our launch in and announce NEXT WEEK. Can we make this happen??”
shots.typography: Notification: white sans on dark grey card; header bold sentence case; body regular sentence case with 'CODE RED:' bold-italic caps and 'NEXT WEEK' italic caps for emphasis. Cursor name tag: small bold name over small regular role. The doc title is cropped to '...nch Plan' at left.
shots.what_happens: Camera holds a tight crop on the CEO comment card (the problem setup) while the voice reacts 'Are you kidding me? There's no way.' (w0-w6). Near 8.0 s a cursor carrying a 'David / Product Manager' name tag enters from lower right and moves left across the doc.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a 2-3x zoomed crop of the app window with a dark rounded notification card (avatar, bold header, three-line message with bold-italic emphasis) pinned upper-right, then animate a labelled presenter cursor in from the lower right in the last second.

shots.focal_element: ClickUp AI 'Create launch plan' modal and its streamed answer, with a 'Create GTM Plans' callout at lower left
shots.transition_other: motion-blurred camera reframe/push from the notification crop down to the doc body (anchors label: other)
on_screen_text: The new launch plan will include
Project Managers, Marketers, and Engineers at mid-sized software companies
Tell AI what to do next
shots.typography: UI in neutral sans (Inter-like, low confidence), regular weight, sentence case; purple filled 'Generate'/'Insert' buttons. Callout card: small purple bold all-caps label 'USE CLICKUP AI TO:' with wide-ish tracking over a large bold dark title-case line, geometric sans (low confidence: brand display face). Streamed answer and the AI Tools menu items are too small in the sheets to quote verbatim and are not counted.
shots.what_happens: After a blurred reframe onto the doc body, the cursor types '/AI Tools', opens a menu of AI actions (items illegible at sheet resolution) and picks one that opens a 'Create launch plan' modal. Fields auto-fill (FocusMaster5000, target audience, tone, creativity) and a 'USE CLICKUP AI TO: Create GTM Plans' callout card appears lower left. On Generate, the modal answers 'Sure, ...' and streams a numbered launch plan, then 'Assigned responsibilities' per team; around 19 s the panel closes and the full plan sits in the doc. VO: 'Actually, maybe you can. Let me see what we can do. Wow.' (w7-w18).
shots.build_rebuild: On a zoomed white doc, type a slash command, pop a shadowed dropdown, open a form modal whose inputs type on in sequence, pin a bordered feature-label card bottom-left, then on button click stream the AI response line by line inside a scrollable modal before collapsing it into the doc body.

shots.focal_element: The completed 'Go-To-Market Launch Plan' doc filled with the AI-generated plan
on_screen_text: The new launch plan will include
1. Define the launch goals and objectives
- Set clear and measurable goals for the launch
- Identify the key performance indicators (KPIs) to track
- Craft a compelling value proposition that resonates with the target audience
- Create messaging that highlights the key benefits of the FocusMaster5000
- Develop a landing page for the product/feature
- Create email campaigns to promote the launch
- Produce social media content to generate buzz
- Write a press release announcing the launch
shots.typography: Doc UI neutral sans (Inter-like, low confidence): large bold title-case title, bold numbered section headings, regular sentence-case bullets; numerals and dashes not counted as words.
shots.what_happens: Camera pulls back out to the full floating window on the teal wallpaper, revealing the doc now populated with the generated four-part launch plan; the labelled cursor drifts slightly at left. VO: 'This is actually pretty good. Time to loop in the team.' (w19-w29).
shots.build_rebuild: Zoom out from the doc body to the full shadowed app window centered on the gradient wallpaper and hold ~3 s on the populated document while a name-tagged cursor idles at left.
